svg.title: ConsultIQ overall architecture
svg.desc: Browser review and revision comparison with draft recovery, an authenticated Next.js API with bounded queries and owner audit history, workspace-scoped Turso storage, separately dispatched analysis, and optional content-free tracing. Hosted credentials and acceptance remain deployment gates.
